current_focus.domain: A clerk manages products and store settings after installing sandboxed Commerce
current_focus.summary: Build Registry-safe sandboxed Commerce with emdash-plugin.jsonc and Block Kit JSON, no browser-side plugin React. Products: add Name and SKU; Name is customer-facing title/H1 contract, no new storefront page. One Save for Regular, Sale, Manage stock and manual stock status. Preserve kernel validation and setup-required, hidden manual statuses when managed, dormant restoration when off, no install popup. Commerce Settings page, Catalog section: Hide out-of-stock products with separate Save. Prove sandbox installation and admin behavior on fresh EmDash 0.41.0 SQLite throwaway. No publishing or live-site changes; Inventory service hosting excluded; unmanaged availability works independently.

decisions.choice: Yes. Preserve the current Products workflow: open a product, type Regular and Sale, and use one Save for prices, Manage stock and unmanaged stock status. Replace native React rendering with host-rendered Block Kit JSON; preserve catalog kernel contracts.

decisions.choice: Yes. Products includes Add product with Name and SKU. After creation open the product for pricing. Manage stock defaults off; creation needs neither developer work nor Inventory setup. Name is the customer-facing product title and supplies the H1 on its customer-facing product page, not a separate internal label. This title contract does not by itself authorize building a new storefront product page in this admin slice.
